captions.detailed: A classic casino slot machine featuring a dark purple-black curved-front cabinet with a rounded top header box. The front of the machine displays a central rectangular reel window revealing three spinning reels, and a slanted lower control panel with two cylindrical push buttons. The base of the unit includes a rectangular cashbox door on the lower front. The reels spin continuously on a horizontal axis, the two buttons depress prismatically inside their collars, and the cashbox door swings open on a vertical side hinge.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of a casino slot machine using CadQuery. The machine should have a main curved-front cabinet with a rounded top marquee, a central slot reel display window, and a lower slanted control panel. Implement continuous rotation for the internal slot reels, prismatic translation for two cylindrical control buttons, and a revolute hinge for a lower cashbox door.
captions.factory: Construct the main slot machine cabinet using a combination of extruded 2D sketches for the side profiles and boolean box subtractions to form the screen and button panel recesses. Model the reels as cylinders arranged horizontally inside the screen opening. Create the control buttons by combining smaller cylinders within outer cylindrical guides, and build the cashbox door as a thin box. Define the continuous joint for the reels, prismatic joints for the buttons, and a revolute joint for the cashbox door using custom articulation definitions.
